geometry_edits.rationale: Tighten the courtyard void so the public open-space figure reads more decisively while preserving the compact bar mass.
Align the carved opening with the verified access side to strengthen the public threshold response at ground level.

graph_edits.rationale: Keep the courtyard open toward the verified access side so the dominant mass continues to register a public threshold on the street edge.
Slightly tighten the courtyard to sharpen the open-space figure without erasing the dominant compact bar.

rationale: The mass reads as a coherent compact street building in all four views, with one dominant volume and a visible carved public void/entry seam rather than random fragments. The green parcel is respected and the blue frontage is answered by a legible ground response, especially through the open/cut condition visible on the plan and opposite views. It is not a perfect fit: the silhouette is somewhat boxy and the section is only moderately expressive, but it still plausibly supports neighborhood-living with active ground and a public threshold. No obvious multi-view collision or only-one-view coherence failure is present.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more compact and object-like; do not copy the spread-out campus strategy directly.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise composition organized around a clear open court, with connected wings and terraced circulation that keeps the street edge legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Use only the threshold logic; the candidate should not become a single-story pavilion.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Simple pavilion massing with a clear entry setback/canopy and a calm, low-rise street response.

warnings: Section is still somewhat generic; upper massing could better articulate the program without becoming sculptural.
The void is effective, but the street-facing threshold could be slightly clearer and more public in section.
